metadata.clearance_scope: Conservative complete drawer shell AABB swept through full -Y travel against fixed structural envelopes. Hardware is constrained within its front envelope. Mortise and fastener overlaps are intentional.
metadata.engine_ownership: Engine owns mechanisms, constraints, colliders, mass, damage response and interaction runtime.
metadata.orientation_convention: Socket/grip basis columns x,y,z are orthonormal right-handed axes in node-local coordinates. Socket normal equals basis.z (outward mounting normal, or hinge pin insertion axis); grip basis.x follows grasp bar and basis.z is outward surface normal. Grip approach is -basis.z. HandleBack rotation_z is pi. Transform axes by owning node rotation for world space.
metadata.socket_coverage_convention: coverage.footprint and component footprint describe full mounting plate width/height on supporting wood, not the lateral or swept extent of the lever. max_projection bounds static outward depth only. support_part_ids names actual supporting solids. Handle/frame and handle/handle motion clearance is not certified.
metadata.source_geometry: Original procedural geometry; no imported assets
metadata.uv_convention: Orthonormal metric planar projection per surface. Coplanar triangulated caps share a common basis. Coordinates are meters and intentionally not packed into 0..1.

parts.attachment: Embedded root, decorative authoring geometry; no detached fragment physics
